mindtraced_atomic_units: The FSM starts in state A.
State A transitions based on input requests (r1, r2, r3).
Device 1 has the highest priority, followed by device 2, then device 3.
The FSM grants access to one device at a time based on priority.
The FSM uses an active-low synchronous reset (Resetn).
